name: runtime_block
description: One row per block emitted with all the block-level diffs and results

bank_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number identifying this block within the current run; the join key from runtime_txn / slot_confirmed / block_equivocated. Restarts at 1 each time a snapshot is loaded, so pair it with the stream's boot id. 0 means unavailable.

block_id.description: Block id of slot (merkle root of the last FEC set)

block_height.description: Block height (count of ancestor blocks) of this block in the chain

leader.description: Scheduled leader identity pubkey for this block

prev_bank_hash.description: Bank hash of the parent slot

accounts_lt_hash_checksum.description: Accounts lattice hash after this slot

poh_hash.description: Proof-of-history hash at the end of the slot (same as blockhash)

clock_sysvar.description: Decoded Clock sysvar for this slot

slot.description: Clock sysvar slot (same as this row's slot)

epoch_start_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the first slot of this epoch

leader_schedule_epoch.description: Epoch whose leader schedule is currently being computed

unix_timestamp.description: Stake-weighted cluster unix timestamp estimate for this slot

recent_blockhashes.description: Newest 151 entries of the blockhash queue at the end of this slot, newest first: exactly the blockhashes a transaction in a child block may reference (age <= 150 inclusive, matching the agave off-by-one in the transaction age check). The first entry is this block's blockhash.

recent_blockhashes_sysvar.description: Decoded RecentBlockhashes sysvar account content at the end of this slot, newest first (the newest 150 blockhash queue entries with their fee calculators)

lamports_per_signature.description: Fee calculator (lamports per signature) in effect when this blockhash was registered

last_restart_slot_sysvar.description: Highest hard fork slot less than or equal to bank slot

num_transactions.description: Total number of transactions committed in this block

num_failed_txns.description: Number of transactions that committed with an error

num_nonvote_txns.description: Number of non-vote transactions committed in this block

num_nonvote_failed_txns.description: Number of non-vote transactions that committed with an error

num_signatures.description: Total number of signatures processed in the block

num_shreds.description: Number of data shreds making up this block

tick_height.description: Cumulative tick height at the end of this block

execution_fees.description: Total execution (base) fees collected in this block, pre-burn

priority_fees.description: Total priority fees collected in this block (priority fees are not burned)

tips.description: Total gross tips credited to tip accounts in this block, before block-level tip commission

fees_burned.description: Lamports burned at fee settlement per the fee schedule (50% of execution fees). If the resolved fee collector fails validation the reward portion is also burned; that case shows up as leader_fee_reward with no matching other_diffs credit.

leader_fee_reward.description: Lamports owed for block production at fee settlement per the fee schedule (priority fees plus unburned execution fees). The actual credit is an other_diffs entry for the resolved fee collector: the leader identity, or the leader vote account's block-revenue collector when custom_commission_collector is active. If the collector fails validation this amount is burned instead and the collector's other_diffs entry shows no balance change.

total_activating_stake.description: Stake activating during this slot's epoch

total_deactivating_stake.description: Stake deactivating during this slot's epoch

total_epoch_stake.description: Total stake delegated to active vote accounts this epoch

sysvar_diffs.description: Final per-account diff of every sysvar account written this block; repeated writes to the same sysvar (e.g. the stake history update then its rent-exemption top-up at an epoch boundary) are coalesced into one entry keeping the first pre-state and last post-state. Ordinary slots carry ~4 entries (Clock, SlotHashes, RecentBlockhashes, SlotHistory; LastRestartSlot only when it changes), boundary/PER slots 5-6. Overflow past the 16-account bound drops the entry with a validator log warning

element.description: Post-state of an updated sysvar account

is_executable.description: True if the post-state account is executable

other_diffs.description: Final per-account diff of non-txn account updates that are not sysvar writes or epoch reward credits (both vote and stake epoch-reward credits are excluded here; see the runtime_reward table). Includes: the block fee credit at settlement (pubkey is the resolved fee collector: the leader identity unless custom_commission_collector routes it to the leader vote account's block-revenue collector; a zero-delta entry means collector validation failed and the reward burned), feature accounts at activation, core-BPF migration writes, and builtin program provisioning. Repeated writes to one account coalesce as in sysvar_diffs. Deliberately excluded as unbounded per-account floods: the per-account VAT-burn debits (see runtime_epoch.vat_burn_per_vote_account) and the per-block alpenglow cert-signer vote state rewrites. Steady state is one entry per block; 32 is an operational bound, not protocol-derived; overflow drops the entry with a validator log warning

is_executable.description: True if the post-state account is executable

fec_count.description: Number of FEC sets observed while assembling this block

fec_merkle_roots.description: Merkle chain of FEC sets observed while assembling this block
